description: For every injective \(a\) and supplied ordinary program \(p\) computing it, the specified program \(Q_p\) satisfies \(E_{\operatorname{range}(a)}(Q_p,s)=\chi_{D_a}(s)\) for every \(s\). It queries each \(x<a(s)\) and tests whether that value is absent from all earlier positions \(i<s\).
